title: Binance Adds ANTA, CBRS, DISK, FOTO, KMEM, QNT and STRC on Binance Stock Trading - 2026-07-06
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region.  Fellow Binancians, To expand the range of trading choices offered on  Binance Stocks  and enhance users’ trading experience, starting from  2026-07-06 13:30 (UTC),  Binance will add the below stocks for trading: Antalpha Platform Holding Co (ANTA) Cerebras Systems (CBRS) Tema Memory ETF (DISK) Tuttle Capital Pure Play Photonics ETF (FOTO) Kurv Memory Select ETF (KMEM) Quantinuum Inc (QNT) Strategy Variable Rate Perpetual Stretch Prf Shs Series A (STRC)  Terms and Conditions: Fully Paid Securities Lending (FPSL) will be eligible when the above stocks from trades are  fully settled . (T+1 trading day) Trading of the aforementioned new stock(s) is subject to eligibility based on the user's country or region of residence.  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise.  Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2026-07-06 Note:  This announcement was amended on 2026-07-06 to revise the list of stocks eligible for trading.
